relationships.evidence_quote: OL-specific Piezo2 deficiency results in age-dependent motor impairment and selective disruption of myelin compaction in small-caliber optic nerve axons

relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, Pde3a, encoding a phosphodiesterase regulating intracellular cAMP levels49, was upregulated in Piezo2-deficient OLs

relationships.evidence_quote: DGE analysis comparing Olig2-cre;Piezo2f/f OLs to Piezo2f/f OLs revealed downregulation of Lama2 in Piezo2-deficient OLs

key_findings: Piezo2 is expressed in late-differentiated mature oligodendrocytes of the mouse optic nerve, and OL-specific deletion causes age-dependent motor deficits and myelin compaction defects in small-caliber axons.
PIEZO2 expression in MAG+ oligodendrocytes is progressively reduced toward multiple sclerosis lesions in human optic nerve.
